notes: Page 25 shows two long pins on a stack of track pieces being discarded; they are not counted as parts.
Inventory element IDs were read from the picture. Several types (4211061, 292626, 346026, 4517986, 4163901 and similar) are guessed from the shape and use.

The 4x8 base plate 4211061 appears twice in the booklet. I took the first as the chassis base and the second as its top plate. 4517986 (black square plate) is assumed to be the turntable base on the chassis. The booklet never shows it being placed.
Placement of the five grille tiles (241226) and some yellow plates is ambiguous in the small drawings. I attached them to plausible cab parts.

In step 17 the bucket replaces the hook head on the boom. I list both the hook assembly and the bucket as joined to the boom end. In the real build only one is attached at a time, so the bucket edge or the hook edge is an alternative configuration.

The excavator and the level crossing are two separate models (bags 1 and 2). The excavator sits on the track but is not joined to it. The fourth track (b63) is only placed loose under the crane on page 41.
Minifig legs are attached to the black cab plate b23. The booklet shows the minifig seated by the blue steering wheel (9566), with no precise stud position given.
Stickers, the hazard stripes and the barrier red stripes are ignored because they are not separate pieces.
Tiles b67 to b74 are attached to the grey 2x4 plate and, for two of them, to the green plates. Their exact stud positions are approximated.
The barrier joins to the black bracket on the signal base through its black arm plate. The booklet does not show the exact studs.
